note: Facts for 'The Firmament' (Pinball). Each fact's `basis` substring must appear in the source chapter's rendered text (tools/verify-pinball.js). Theme: order struck out of the primordial chaos — the making of the cosmos.

facts.label: The cosmic egg
facts.fact: A single seed hatches the cosmos — the Rigveda's golden Hiranyagarbha, the Orphic world-egg — the cosmic egg recurs across traditions.

facts.label: The primordial ocean
facts.fact: Egypt's world rises from Nun, the limitless primordial ocean, on a first mound of dry earth — the oldest cosmogonies begin wet.

facts.label: Marduk and Tiamat
facts.fact: In the Enuma Elish the god Marduk hacks in two the salt-sea monster Tiamat and builds the world from her body — order won by combat.

facts.label: The sacrifice of Purusha
facts.fact: The Rigveda's Purusha Sukta sacrifices the cosmic Man Purusha — the moon from his mind, the sun from his eye — the world built from a body.

facts.label: The body of Ymir
facts.fact: The Norse gods slay the frost-giant Ymir and make the earth from his flesh, the sea from his blood, the mountains from his bones.

facts.label: The act of separation
facts.fact: The commonest creative act is separation: sky from earth, waters above from below, light from dark — creation as the drawing of distinctions.

facts.label: The Ogdoad
facts.fact: Hermopolis begins with the Ogdoad, eight primeval deities in pairs, while Genesis orders creation into a seven-day week.

facts.label: The golden womb
facts.fact: The Rigveda's Hiranyagarbha is the golden womb from which all things are born, floating on the primal waters.
